summary: Retested the four reported bugs at 390x844. All pass. (1) Multi-select ticks are square (border-radius 5px, role=checkbox) and single-select ticks are round (9999px, role=radio). (2) Q17 meme question at step 21 shows a 2-column grid (169px x2) with 8 tiles: 7 real photos, all loaded (naturalWidth 215-480), plus a 💅 emoji tile for 'So beautiful, so elegant'. Selecting one sets aria-checked=true, auto-advances exactly one step and saves on the server. (3) Persistence: answered weather/area/food/dessert, went Back 4 steps and every selection was intact. Reload on /journey resumes at the same step with server answers intact. A quick multi tap then Next then Back keeps the new tick. Re-tapping a selected single option keeps it and advances. No autosave toasts appeared. (4) Double-tapping two different single options moves forward only one step, and the last tap is the one saved. (5) Edit from a completed profile (/journey?step=1, X exit): a changed multi answer and a changed single answer (exit 100ms after the tap) both show correctly on re-edit and on the server. (6) Photo: picking a file shows the cropper, the Next/Skip buttons are replaced by the 'Tap “Use this” above…' hint, and 'Use this' uploads the photo. The preview image loads (640px) with Replace/Remove and 'Saved', and Next returns. After finishing, My card's profile-card-photo contains a loaded . Note, consent (default off) and the reveal flip all work. Backend regression: 14/14 pass after one test was updated.

ui_bugs.issue: The ?step= query always overrides the saved step and the URL never changes as the user moves. If someone enters edit via /journey?step=1, moves ahead and reloads, they jump back to step 1. Answers are kept; only the position is lost.

The exit button does not flush pending debounced multi-select saves (450ms timer) before refresh() and nav('/me'). My card can briefly show stale data, and an answer is lost if the tab closes within 450ms. It worked in testing because the timer still fires after unmount.

action_items: Optional: on journey-exit-btn, flush pending timers.current saves (await the putRetry calls) before refresh/nav.
Optional: keep ?step in sync with the current step (setSearchParams replace), or drop it after the first read, so reload during edit resumes correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: putRetry retries 5xx up to 4 times with backoff. An older answer PUT that is retrying can land after a newer PUT for the same question and overwrite it (no ordering or version check). Consider aborting the earlier request per qid, or sending a client timestamp/sequence that the server checks.
Journey.jsx nextLabel has a redundant ternary for photo ('Next →' : 'Next →').
